title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in CRM Perks CRM…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in CRM Perks Forms up to version 1.1.8. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in users' browsers. The vulnerability is rated high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1. No patch or remediation information is currently provided.
